content.title: NSK 6202-ZZ Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 15mm x 35mm x 11mm, Metal Shielded, Steel Cage
content.short_description: NSK 6202-ZZ single-row deep groove ball bearing with metal shields (ZZ), 15mm bore, 35mm OD, 11mm width. Dynamic load rating 7.65 kN, static load rating 3.75 kN.
content.long_description:
The NSK 6202-ZZ is a single-row deep groove ball bearing with a 15 mm bore, 35 mm outer diameter, and 11 mm width, fitting standard 6202-series housings and shaft dimensions. The bearing uses ZZ-type metal shields on both sides to retain lubricant and restrict entry of dust and debris in the operating environment, and it is equipped with a steel cage for ball retention and spacing.

Load ratings are specified as a dynamic load rating (C) of 7.65 kN and a static load rating (C0) of 3.75 kN, applicable to radial and combined loading conditions typical of deep groove ball bearing applications. The bearing carries a limiting speed rating of 24,000 rpm, referring to the maximum rotational speed under specified operating conditions.

This bearing type is used in general industrial rotating equipment, including motors, pumps, gearboxes, and conveyor systems, where a compact metric bearing with shielded protection is required. The 6202 bore/OD/width combination is a common ABMA/ISO standard size, allowing for interchange with equivalent metric deep groove ball bearings sharing the same envelope dimensions.
